Description of the job : Onsite commissioning and support/troubleshooting of a redundant network serving a site-wide electrical control system based on an existing design. Remote support will be provided throughout. 
Work duration: 12 days + additional 3 days of travelling and medical. Please allow for a contingency of 4 days additional work. 
Location: Oman oil field - transport from Muscat to oil field assured using plane 
Dates: Mid-September or as early as possible. 
Original requirements for the job: 
Experience level / skill set : 
- Strong understanding of industrial Ethernet networks with hands-on experience 
- Experience with installing and commissioning Hirschmann network switches 
- Experience with performing firmware updates, configuration management 
- Experience with troubleshooting redundancy configurations, with remote support 
- General experience with optical fibre installations and troubleshooting industrial networks 
- Preferably experience with IEDs/protection relays and networks serving electrical controls systems (preferred but not compulsory.)) 
- Ability to work in desert environment (note that the majority of the work will be done in substations) 
- Ability to interpret network diagrams 
- Good English level required 
Certifications: Not required (CCNA/P or equivalent - preferred but not compulsory) 
Health check: Will be provided by client
